articles.title: Bitwise cuts 14% of staff while still expecting growth
articles.snippet: Crypto companies from including Coinbase, BitGo, Robinhood, Polygon and Pump.fun have announced workforce reductions this year, citing a variety of reasons, including shifting to AI and market forces.

articles.title: Crypto companies urge AI firms to give Bitcoin developers early access
articles.snippet: The Bitcoin Policy Institute and other industry participants urged AI companies to offer early access to their frontier models to aid Bitcoin and open-source developers in their cybersecurity efforts.

articles.title: SEC to address crypto regulations in absence of CLARITY passage
articles.snippet: The US securities regulator scheduled a meeting this week with the potential to step up on digital asset policies without congressional action.

articles.title: UK Lawmakers Write to Bank CEOs Over Crypto Account Refusals
articles.snippet: The APPG has asked banks to explain their crypto policies, warning that access could be one of the single biggest barriers to growth.
